about.description: My work combines Angular engineering, responsive and RTL interfaces, API integration, and practical mentoring — with an emphasis on building software that is structured, maintainable, and useful.

story.label: How I work
story.title: I care about the structure behind the interface.
story.paragraph1: I translate product requirements into Angular applications with clear component boundaries, predictable data flow, reusable UI, and an architecture that stays practical as the application grows.
story.paragraph2: My work includes Angular Signals, Reactive Forms, routing, RxJS, authentication flows, guards, interceptors, REST API integration, responsive layouts, and Arabic RTL experiences.
